description:
What we can see about one x402 pay-to address on Base: how many registrations name it, whether they share one owner, which registration its payments are credited to, and x402 payments seen (count and USDC, all time and 30 days).

Facts only. Base only; only x402 settlements visible in USDC transfer logs; a payment shows money reached the address, not which service was bought. The registrations listed name the address in their own files; that is not a statement about who controls it.

Paid counterpart: `GET /v1/intel/address/base/{address}` (x402, $0.01 USDC, the same price as the single-agent lookup) returns the full record with the registration list and payer breakdown. The `next_step` block carries the exact URL and price.
name: get_address_record
